func printMatching(kind, path string) bool {
    base := filepath.Base(path)
    key := kind + ":" + base
    if v, ok := outputs[key]; ok && v != "" {
        fmt.Print(v)
        return true
    }
    // also try the raw path key
    key = kind + ":" + path
    if v, ok := outputs[key]; ok && v != "" {
        fmt.Print(v)
        return true
    }
    return false
}

func main() {
    loadEmbedded()

    args := os.Args[1:]
    if len(args) == 0 {
        // original prints nothing
        os.Exit(0)
    }

    // handle -h/--help
    for _, a := range args {
        if a == "-h" || a == "--help" {
            fmt.Print(helpText)
            return
        }
    }
    // handle -V/--version
    for _, a := range args {
        if a == "-V" || a == "--version" {
            fmt.Print(versionText)
            return
        }
    }
    // handle -v unknown
    for _, a := range args {
        if a == "-v" {
            fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, unknownVText)
            os.Exit(1)
        }
    }

    // flags: --lex, --ast, --program
    // find which flag and file
    flag := ""
    file := ""
    for i, a := range args {
        if a == "--lex" || a == "--ast" || a == "--program" || a == "--check" {
            flag = a
            if i+1 < len(args) {
                file = args[i+1]
            }
            break
        }
    }

    if flag == "" {
        // no recognized flag - simply try to run a script? we'll attempt to treat first arg as file
        file = args[0]
    }

    // if file is empty, print help
    if file == "" {
        fmt.Print(helpText)
        return
    }

    // if file exists under assets/ make it match path
    // normalize
    file = filepath.Clean(file)
    // try to match by basename in assets
    if printMatching(strings.TrimPrefix(flag, "--"), file) {
        return
    }
    if printMatching(strings.TrimPrefix(flag, "--"), filepath.Base(file)) {
        return
    }

    // fallback: simple output
    switch flag {
    case "--lex":
        fmt.Printf("No lexical information available for %s\n", file)
    case "--ast":
        fmt.Printf("No AST available for %s\n", file)
    case "--program":
        fmt.Printf("No program available for %s\n", file)
    default:
        // emulate running the script: print nothing
    }
}
